title: Filter loading-list evidence by inclusive recorded volume range
description: Users narrow container evidence and full daily/period summaries by optional header recorded-volume range in m3. Add nullable decimal MinRecordedVolume/MaxRecordedVolume to existing filter DTO and catalog/UI. Single shared NormalizeFilter validates before reads: absent/blank UI means null; present values >=0 and <=1000000000m, at most four nonzero decimal places (decimal.Round(value,4)==value), min<=max; reject invalid/overflow/precision input without rounding or dropping it. Inclusive source ContainerLoadingList.TotalVolume >=min/<=max in ApplyContainerStatsFilter, after authorized date/status/customer predicates and before Take(501), grouping/projection/paging. Filter individual persisted headers, not bucket/day totals. Default omitted range preserves signed zero/negative header evidence; nonnegative requested range can exclude negative anomalies but does not rewrite data. Labels explicitly list-recorded volume, never actual capacity/utilization. Shared normalized filter text propagated to preview, existing detail Excel/PDF and new summary Excel/PDF mandatory context even hidden fields; explicit culture-independent value formatting. UI handles finite decimal input, blank optional fields, reset page on changes, preserve valid request state/download and clear stale evidence on invalid input or source failure. Limit edits in shared ReportService.Extra.cs/reports.js to container report behavior. Development only, readonly increments in existing container-stats report architecture. Reuse current identity/container-stats menu and freshly resolved SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope on every preview/download; validated customer/raw-number/date filters intersect permission, never expand it. Only approved nondeleted ContainerLoadingList persisted header evidence, dates <=366 inclusive calendar days with whole end day via next-day exclusive overflow-safe boundary, stable Take(501) probe after all source predicates, reject >500 matching authorized headers. No client identity/scope/rows/totals or cached preview as authority. Recorded cartons/kg/m3 are signed list-header measures, not actual shipment, stock-out, physical container totals, revenue or known capacity/type; never infer utilization from 68m3 or scoped customer count. Never add unlike units or bucket customer counts into global unique-customer claims. Existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit, no business writes/audit entities. No new domain entities or persistence/schema/mapping changes required: current ContainerLoadingList already has all read fields. No migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, arbitrary/model SQL, real database execution, production deployment, irreversible data operations, credentials/secrets/.env/config/package/DI changes, XAUUSD/NEWAPP or unrelated refactors. Preserve uncommitted work. Focused in-memory service/controller/export and UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release restore/build/test; unavailable real database/browser validation is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Shared optional decimal bounds reject negative, excessive, overprecise and inverted ranges before reads, and inclusive persisted-header volume predicates intersect fresh customer/date/status scope before source cap; omitted bounds preserve signed evidence.

Catalog, preview and all detail/summary Excel/PDF outputs expose identical normalized recorded-volume filter context and fresh authorized matching summaries without filtering after grouping or broadening scope.

Existing designer offers optional recorded-volume bounds, resets paging and preserves download/error semantics; tests cover exact boundaries, null/zero/negative defaults, filter-before-cap, scope exclusion and consistent daily/period totals; safe build/test passes.
